Sample data for the win-ioring test suite.

This file exists so the tests have a fixture of stable, known length that
nothing else in the repository is free to rewrite. They previously read
README.md, which coupled every read test to the project's documentation: a
rewrite of the README would silently change what the tests were reading, and a
short README would break the tests that read a fixed number of bytes.

Do not shorten this file below 512 bytes, and prefer appending to editing, so
that offsets used by existing tests keep pointing at the same bytes.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor
jugs. How vexingly quick daft zebras jump. Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
The five boxing wizards jump quickly. Jackdaws love my big sphinx of quartz.
Bright vixens jump; dozy fowl quack. Waltz, nymph, for quick jigs vex Bud.
